resources.string: The configuration file of the app is damaged.
Enter the address of your monitor and its token in the settings.
This is the Lite edition of the monitor: it has no alerts, repositories or proposals. The app needs the Complete edition.
The monitor cannot reach GitHub right now.
The monitor has not read GitHub yet.
Only the %1$d with most risk are listed. Search by name for the others.
Red workflows: %1$d · Alerts: %2$d · Failures in 24 h: %3$d
Read only: the monitor accepts approval or rejection only on its own computer.
AI proposals are switched off on this monitor.
The link was made for different content than the monitor holds now. Check the proposal on the monitor.
A token is stored, sealed on this phone. Leave empty to keep it.
It is sent to the monitor once and not kept.
This monitor also asks you to sign in.
Connected: the monitor accepted the token.
The token was removed from this phone.

On the monitor: turn on listen.network, put this address in listen.allowed_hosts if it is a name, and use the access token of the network mode (set it in MONITOR_ACCESS_TOKEN so it does not change at each start). With users (team mode), turn on auth.allow_bearer as well.
Enter the address of the monitor.
Use an address that starts with https:// (or http:// on the home network).
The address has no valid host name.
Do not put a user or password in the address.
The address must not have a query or a fragment.
Plain http:// is only accepted for localhost, .local names and private addresses. Use https:// for any other host.
The access token was refused. Check it in the settings.
The monitor does not accept this address. Add it to listen.allowed_hosts on the monitor.
Too many wrong attempts: the monitor locked this phone out for a few minutes.
Sign in again in the settings.
The monitor does not give sessions to apps. Turn on auth.allow_bearer on the monitor.
The monitor asks for users but has no administrator yet. Create it on the computer of the monitor.
Your role does not allow this.
Your user cannot see this account.
The monitor does not have this. The Lite edition has no alerts, repositories or proposals.
Too many requests. Wait a moment.
The monitor did not accept the request.
The monitor had an internal error.
Cannot reach the monitor. Check the address, that the monitor runs in network mode and that the phone is on the same network.
The monitor sent an answer the app cannot read.
Enter the address and token of the monitor in the settings first.
